summary: Frontend code review for compensation UI sync between Admin and Coach views. All requested UI changes verified via code review. Playwright visual testing limited due to React Native Web login button click issues (TouchableOpacity not responding to standard click events).

integration_issues.issue: React Native Web TouchableOpacity button does not respond reliably to Playwright clicks. Requires coordinate-based clicking with specific y-position detection.
integration_issues.notes: This is a known React Native Web limitation, not a bug in the app

critical_code_review_comments: All requested features verified via code review
Admin view (/app/frontend/app/admin/coach/[id].tsx) - RAS box (lines 1218-1224): Linear layout with bullet points and bold values CORRECTLY IMPLEMENTED
Admin view - Annual boxes (lines 1246-1251, 1288-1291): Bold values for Compenso base, Somme suppl., Totale Anno CORRECTLY IMPLEMENTED
Coach view (/app/frontend/app/coach/compensation.tsx) - RAS box (lines 1014-1020): Same linear layout with bullet points and bold values CORRECTLY IMPLEMENTED
Coach view - Annual boxes (lines 1049-1055, 1093-1096): Bold values CORRECTLY IMPLEMENTED
Both views now synchronized with identical layout structure
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow requires clicking at specific coordinates (960, 697) for the Accedi button due to React Native Web TouchableOpacity limitations. Role selection card needs similar coordinate-based clicking.
